memories.content: Dario wants Selin to play bass at his October wedding. He has messaged her asking whether she will. He does not know her current schedule or intentions.

Dario and Selin were bandmates in a band that dissolved two years ago on good terms. Dario has sent Selin a message asking if she will play bass at his October wedding. The message was sent before the simulation start time.
